method: Whitened STFT chroma versus tempo-decoded note-duration chroma; bounded scale .7–1.5 and offset -4–8s; first <=65s; no drum-channel notes. Candidate ranking only, not percentage fidelity.
limits: MIDI sustain pedal, effects and pitch bends summarized but not synthesized in chroma
Percussion, intros, loops and tuning can reduce discrimination
Controls intentionally permit a wrong original to expose false positives; no pass threshold manufactured
Short-stinger wrong-original control may have no valid overlap; null means unavailable, not a low fidelity score.
Channel 10 is treated as default percussion; nonstandard GS/XG drum remaps require separate inspection. Pitch class comparison cannot verify bass octave, expressive synthesis or exact notes.
